channel.title: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)" - Just use SCP-500

item.title: Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: Given the extremely negative responses to recent attempts to write up the COVID pandemic as an anomaly, it's probably not a good idea to encourage people do so. Members of the SCP wiki community have lost loved ones to coronavirus; attributing that very real life tragedy to a fictionalized anomalous version can come off as incredibly tactless.

item.title: Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: Don't have any salutations, just gotta say I'm looking forward to someone making an article out of Covid

item.title: Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
Re: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: If I'm not mistaken, the whole hook of 500 was supposed to be that we had a limited panacea, and that we only had a couple more pills to use. We wouldn’t be able to use it on everyone.

item.title: Idea to prevent covid (In the SCP universe that is)
item.content:encoded: If it cures all diseases. Just give it to everyone, the foundation can set up stations where every person that is infected gets the pill and his problems are over. No need for selling it just giving it to the infected. Problem solved but that is just my idea. I know this is a huge time waster but if you have any opinions I would like to read them. Always interesting when other people comment on crazy and or stupid ideas.
